examples: The candidate distinguishes the basic entry path actually taught from prompting, source-verification, and error-correction methods that the video does not teach.
It identifies UI states and one bounded image before/after difference as the strongest visible proof.
It preserves authority, competitive superiority, source quality, free scope, and the AI-search-ceiling claim as unverified author claims or unknowns.
It reconstructs the hook-to-office-to-health-to-image-to-CTA persuasion chain.
All 18 core knowledge units have resolvable evidence references.
The HTML/PPT paths and visible limitations are supported by targeted frames and manually reviewed OCR.
The cat-source UI, medical-result boundary, image-edit before/after scope, free/ceiling CTA, and full-timeline absences are evidenced at their proper carrier levels.
The report title is scoped to how this author recommends Quark Deep Search rather than asserting a universal AI-search diagnosis.
KU-16 limits the observed edit result to one clearly visible man no longer appearing rather than claiming that an entire crowd was removed.

KU-24 now supplies explicit reasoning from six contiguous listening observations to a video-scoped non-speech-audio conclusion while preserving music identity, licensing, and masked low-level effects as unknown.
All 90 checked cue, shot, targeted-frame, and OCR references intersect their stated unit ranges within the evaluation tolerance.
KU-03 is now limited to CUE-004 and CUE-005 at 15.19-24.55; the later CUE-014 claim remains localized in KU-10.
Image copyright and portrait/permission unknowns are explicit.
Privacy/data use, content/material copyright, latency, and performance variability are recorded as video-scope absences rather than product nonexistence claims.
Presenter qualifications and whether she personally performed every recording/test remain explicitly unknown.
